invariants.rationale: Minimum width values are non-negative in UI layouts; method always returns a maximum of such values.

invariants.expression: result == Math.max(super.getPrefWidth(), Math.max((style.up != null ? style.up.getMinWidth() : Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY), Math.max((style.down != null ? style.down.getMinWidth() : Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY), (style.checked != null ? style.checked.getMinWidth() : Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY))))
invariants.rationale: The return value is the maximum among super.getPrefWidth() and the min widths of relevant style fields if present.
The returned width is always at least as large as the result of super.getPrefWidth().
If style.up is not null, its getMinWidth() is never greater than result, since result is the maximum.
The same maximum logic applies to style.down.
